changelog: Lock any note with a PIN, password or pattern: it stays encrypted on every device until you decrypt it. "Syncing..." shows while notes come in, and no more conflict copies. Mind maps wrap their text and take sub-texts; lists can wrap too. Your vault's Drive backup opens with your main vault lock or a backup lock of its own. Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ for Windows 11: an installer that updates itself, the Editor for .txt files that stay in your notes, locked notes, and your vault on Google Drive.
